shortDescription: Various redis commands, replica and flush

options.name: ca_certs
options.description: Path to root certificates file. If not set and O(tls) is set to V(true), certifi's CA certificates are used.

options.name: client_cert_file
options.description: Path to the client certificate file.

options.name: client_key_file
options.description: Path to the client private key file.

options.name: command
options.description: The selected redis command. V(config) ensures a configuration setting on an instance. V(flush) flushes all the instance or a specified db. V(replica) sets a redis instance in replica or master mode. (V(slave) is an alias for V(replica)).

options.name: db
options.description: The database to flush (used in DB mode) [flush command].

options.name: flush_mode
options.description: Type of flush (all the DBs in a redis instance or a specific one) [flush command].

options.name: login_host
options.description: Specify the target host running the database.

options.name: login_password
options.description: Specify the password to authenticate with. Usually not used when target is localhost.

options.name: login_port
options.description: Specify the port to connect to.

options.name: login_user
options.description: Specify the user to authenticate with. Requires L(redis,https://pypi.org/project/redis) >= 3.4.0.

options.name: master_host
options.description: The host of the master instance [replica command].

options.name: master_port
options.description: The port of the master instance [replica command].

options.name: replica_mode
options.description: The mode of the redis instance [replica command]. V(slave) is an alias for V(replica).

options.name: tls
options.description: Specify whether or not to use TLS for the connection.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Specify whether or not to validate TLS certificates. This should only be turned off for personally controlled sites or with C(localhost) as target.

options.name: value
options.description: A redis config value. When memory size is needed, it is possible to specify it in the usual form of 1KB, 2M, 400MB where the base is 1024. Units are case insensitive, in other words 1m = 1mb = 1M = 1MB.
